components.title: Heritage Cluster (experimental)
components.description: STILL UNDER DEVELOPMENT, NOT YET TESTED IN A REAL CAR (a test in a car is coming soon). Classic BMW instrument clusters shown on your car's digital cluster in place of the stock dials: the E-series analogue cluster (X5 E53, 5 Series E39) and the F-series digital display (X5 F15, X6 F16, 5 Series F10, 7 Series F01) in Comfort and Sport. For any iDrive 7 car with the 12.3-inch cluster; laid out on a G05 X5. Use it at your own risk: try it parked first and uninstall it if anything looks wrong. Provided as is, with no warranty; the author is not responsible for any damage, fault or other consequence of using it.
